meta.title: Medical Board Review
meta.description: 18 high-yield flashcards for USMLE/board review across cardiology, neurology, pulmonology, pharmacology, and gastroenterology

cards.front: What is the most common cause of heart failure?
cards.back: Coronary artery disease (accounts for 50-60% of cases)
Beta-blockers — they reduce myocardial oxygen demand by decreasing heart rate and contractility

cards.front: Most common cause of secondary hypertension in young adults
cards.back: Primary aldosteronism (Conn syndrome) — suspect in resistant hypertension with hypokalemia

cards.front: Gold standard for diagnosing pulmonary embolism
GOLD stage classification for COPD severity based on FEV1
cards.back: GOLD 1: ≥80% — Mild | GOLD 2: 50-79% — Moderate | GOLD 3: 30-49% — Severe | GOLD 4: <30% — Very Severe
Smoking cessation slows disease progression. Long-term oxygen therapy (PaO2 <55 or SpO2 <88%) also reduces mortality.

cards.front: Time window for IV alteplase (tPA) in ischemic stroke
cards.back: Within 3 hours of symptom onset (extended to 4.5 hours for eligible patients)

cards.front: Classic triad of bacterial meningitis in CSF
cards.back: 1) Elevated WBC (polymorphonuclear predominance) | 2) Low glucose | 3) High protein

cards.front: Most common bacterial cause of meningitis in adults
First-line triple therapy for H. pylori eradication
Most common source of upper GI bleeding in patients with portal hypertension
cards.back: Esophageal varices (caput medusae and splenomegaly are physical exam clues)

cards.front: Most common cause of acute bacterial gastroenteritis
cards.back: Campylobacter jejuni (from undercooked poultry, incubation 12-72 hours)
Inhibit angiotensin-converting enzyme → decreased angiotensin II → vasodilation, decreased aldosterone, decreased afterload
Partial agonist at alpha-4 beta-2 nicotinic acetylcholine receptors — reduces cravings and blocks nicotine reward

cards.front: Management of warfarin with INR >5 and minor bleeding
cards.back: Hold warfarin + give vitamin K 1-2.5 mg orally. High-dose vitamin K or FFP reserved for major bleeding.
Resting tremor (pill-rolling), bradykinesia, cogwheel rigidity, postural instability — asymmetric onset

cards.front: Triple therapy for HFrEF with strongest mortality benefit
cards.back: ACE inhibitor (or ARB) + Beta-blocker + Aldosterone antagonist
